proof_obligations.PO-INSTRUMENT: Reversible public frequency evaluation, word Fourier erasure and group Fourier readout use each unknown input once. Charge every measurement branch and retained root.
proof_obligations.PO-NORMALIZATION: The zero erasure branch has joint correct probability exactly1/q^n, regardless of batch density. Its conditional correctness must not replace correct yield; reciprocal yield is not a correctness flag.
proof_obligations.PO-FEEDFORWARD: Rescue only characters with chi_q(delta.F)=chi_3(t.x) for every word. The elementary correction image has rank at most n, so direct correct yield is at most3^(-n*(r-1)).
proof_obligations.PO-COMPLETENESS: Local mod3 frequency span certifies full ring span. Only then are all corrections order-three secrets and the quadratic nullspace complete. Deficient span must retain incomplete status.
proof_obligations.PO-INFORMATION: The source two-point law implies mean ideal PGM failure <=(q^n-1)/3^(dB). This is an information-theoretic ensemble bound, not an efficient measurement or a fixed-instance certificate.
proof_obligations.PO-ALL-RECORDS: All outcome likelihoods factor into local Fourier probabilities at one shared shifted secret. Keeping every record is not ruled out by exact-character yield. Current classical MAP enumerates q^n secrets and joint outcomes.
proof_obligations.PO-ERROR: IID source supply and channel errors remain external. Neither deterministic ancestry IDs nor arithmetic controls certify physical independence or error accumulation.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: Do not claim impossibility of noncharacter, approximate, outcome-adaptive or source-aware collective transforms, or of classical statistical decoding from all records. No novelty or speedup is claimed.

falsifiable_experiments: An alleged exact character has a nonzero modular residual at any native word.
Actual word-erasure and group-Fourier amplitudes violate the exact joint-yield formula.
A complete correction image disagrees with exhaustive full-ring search at bounded controls.
All-record likelihood witnesses disagree with the actual instrument or exceed optimal PGM success.
Conditional success, source-state inverse, refreshed higher secret or omitted original ancestry is treated as free.
